title: Online shop or brand that sells products
basis: Recalled general knowledge, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). Google's own link-spam page names 'sending a product in exchange for a write-up with a link' as a violation unless the link is qualified; the pack repeats it.

domainTypes.note: review profile shown in search results when enough reviews exist
a sales channel; no followed link; brand registry strengthens the entity
a sales channel; shop page can carry the website in About

patterns.why: a gift guide or product review site
a coupon or deal site (usually affiliate; links are paid)

angles: Get on the 'where to buy' and stockist pages of every retailer and partner that sells or uses the products.
Send gift-guide and roundup editors samples and a one-page fact sheet 8 to 10 weeks before the season; if a link comes from a gift, the editor must be free to mark it rel="sponsored".
Turn product data (return rates, sizes, materials, price history) into one citable study a year.
Find unlinked brand mentions (search the brand name) and ask politely for a link where the mention is already positive.
Support one cause tied to the product, with a sponsor-page mention.
Collect product reviews with the shop's own review tool, from real buyers only, and keep the review markup truthful.
avoid: Free products in return for a link without rel="sponsored" (named in Google's link-spam list).
Affiliate and coupon sites that rank for your brand name; their links are paid by commission.
Reviews you wrote, bought or gated.
Widgets or badges with keyword links distributed to other sites.
